proposed_finite_time_reference.loss_bound: For every species i, K_i=sum_e k_e max(y_i-yprime_i,0) product_j m_j^(y_j-1_{j=i}). A consumed species has y_i>=1,so exponents are nonnegative. On the simplex,each loss monomial<=x_i product_j m_j^(y_j-1_{j=i});production is nonnegative. Hence f_i(x)>=-K_i x_i.
proposed_finite_time_reference.continuous_reference: With polynomial local existence/uniqueness,conservation and boundary quasipositivity,compact continuation and the differential inequality give x_i(t)>=x_i(0) exp(-K_i t)>0 on every finite interval. A separate verifier must justify each reaction certificate against the whole input,not merely assert weak reversibility.
proposed_finite_time_reference.critical_limit: The lower bound depends on x0,t and can decay to zero as t grows. It is not liminf persistence,not a uniform eventual epsilon_P,not an absorbing-set computation,not a nonlinear trajectory approximation andnot an Euler accuracy guarantee. It uses ordinary differential-inequality/conservation reasoning independently of new permanence.
